crossRefs.note: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
crossRefs.keyword: because they were exceeding many. Heb. for the exceedingmultitude

crossRefs.note: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million…
of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

parallels.note: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance; for the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
translations.bsb: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
translations.kjv: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
translations.asv: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: the weight of the brass could not be found out.
